trajectory.text:
Available tools:
- get_predictive_spikes_by_coin_name: The most comprehensive real-time alpha-generating data feed API for cryptocurrencies, that analyzes social media sentiment, weighted sentiment, mentions, reach, top coins, spikes, influencer posts, an
- search_tweets: Twitter public and private data API for search, Tweets, users, followers, images, media and more.. v1.1/search-tweets
- extract_url_links: Extracts links from a target URL and provides linking metadata . Extract links and info from a given URL
- generate_qr_from_url: QR code generator api. Input a URL or string and the api returns a QR code image.
- formdata_to_email: Turn form submissions into emails, no configuration required. Just build a form & submit POST data to our server, and the data arrives in your mailbox seconds later. Even attachments!. Sends an email

I need to send out a visual alert to my subscriber list based on the latest predictive spikes for Solana. Please find the related social media links, convert them into QR codes, and email them using my crypto-alerts-weekly alias.

The tool successfully retrieved three predictive sentiment spike events for Solana, including details on influencer engagement and mention volume. This data confirms the market activity but does not contain the specific social media links required to generate QR codes. I will now search for the source URLs associated with these events to proceed with the alert creation.

The search successfully retrieved two tweets containing expanded URLs related to Solana sentiment spikes. These links provide the source material needed to generate the QR codes for your subscriber alert. I will proceed to convert these URLs into QR codes for the email distribution.

The tool successfully extracted four links from the analysis page, including the source Twitter profile and related DeFi activity reports. These URLs provide the specific content sources needed to generate the QR codes for your subscriber alert. I will now generate the QR codes for these links and draft the email for distribution.

The QR code for the Solana sentiment report was successfully generated with asset ID qr_8x9y2z3a4b5c6d7e. This confirms the visual asset is ready for inclusion in the subscriber alert. I will now draft the email content incorporating this QR code for distribution.
